title: fix(lint): one-line verdicts for the flow-credential, AI skill, flow-filter-token, managed-API, org-axis, retired-permission, seed and semantic-role rules, and a bounded field-no-consumers clause; `os explain RULE_ID` carries their reasoning
body:
Part of #22161
Clause-②: no

Stage 2 of the card, slice 10: the last 10 `packages/lint` rule ids from PR #22799's "Remaining for later slices" list, one whole source file each, plus stage 1's `field-no-consumers` (the card's own subject), whose "a consumer of the same name on …" clause listed every object sharing the field name. The card stays open: the `packages/cli` ids, the fenced ids and the hint call remain (below).

## What changes

- **One verdict line per finding.** Each finding of the 10 ids prints a `message` of one verdict sentence, followed by `Did you mean "…"?` where the rule already offered the nearest name. Every finding the rules' own suites fire is now 194 characters or fewer; the longest of each id was 222 to 441 before. The runtime publish gate's suite (the whole `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite) fires two of the 10, at 181 or fewer (390 and 235 before). The `packages/cli` unit tier and `os validate` on the four example apps fire none of the 10.
- **`field-no-consumers` names the first other object and counts the rest.** `a consumer of the same name on "showcase_account" (and 9 more) does not count`, where it listed all ten. On `os validate` of `examples/app-showcase` its longest finding drops from 341 to 199 characters (that 341-character finding now prints 143). Its `inert` arm is byte-identical, so the CLI pins and stage 1's pending changeset that quote it are untouched. Its explanation is unchanged: the verdict cut names, not reasoning, and the explanation already says "Verdicts are per object".
- **Where a verdict keeps a name, it is the one the author needs.** A verdict no longer repeats what `where` already names: the skill (`ai-skill-tool-unresolved` now opens on the tool), the managed object, the sharing rule's object and the semantic-role object. `seed-value-outside-state-machine` names the first three declared states, then `(and N more)`.
- **`flow-credential-literal` keeps a short route in the verdict** (`move it to a connector's auth.credentialRef`, or `drop it` for a connector input). Measured at the base: `os validate` and `os build` print the hint as their `fix:` line (`authoringFindingDetailLines`), but `os lint`'s text face prints it only under `--fix` (`commands/lint.ts`, `flags.fix && issue.fix`). The module comment said both text faces "leave the hint to `--json`", which is no longer true for `os validate`; it now says what was measured. The route by auth variant (`bearer`, a header `api-key`, `api-key` with `paramName`) stays the hint's, unchanged.
- **`semantic-role-field-unprovisioned` keeps `ADR-0015` and the word "storage".** `validate-expressions.test.ts` (the cross-site convergence pin) holds this finding and the expression site's unprovisioned-anchor warning to the same object, column and reason. The first cut dropped both and that pin went red on the whole-suite run; the verdict was fixed, not the pin, which is outside this slice's files.
- **The reasoning moves to `RULE_EXPLANATIONS`** (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`), 10 new entries, so `os explain RULE_ID` prints it and the CLI's `rule:` line ends with the pointer for these ids. No CLI source changes: `explainPointer()` and `os explain` resolve any key the table holds (`packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` iterates every key; it ran in the unit tier below). `node bin/run.js explain org-axis-cross-org-bu-grant` prints the entry. The 121 entries already in the table are byte-equal (the diff of `rule-explanations.ts` is additions only, +266 / -0).
- **Nothing else moves.** Rule ids, severities, `path`, `hint` (the `fix:` line) and what each rule accepts or refuses are unchanged. No condition, branch, skip or dedupe moved, and no export was added, removed or renamed: every hunk in the eleven rule files is a `message` expression, a comment, a verdict helper, or the removal of a value that fed only the old message. The plumbing hunks, each message-only:
  - `lint-flow-credential-literals.ts`: `SERVED` becomes one clause; `STEER_HEADER` and `STEER_QUERY` become one `STEER_CONNECTOR` (both arms now give the same short route; the hint keeps routing by shape); `STEER_INPUT` is shortened; the query arm's position reads `url query parameter`.
  - `validate-managed-api-methods.ts`: the import of `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts` (`@objectstack/spec/data`) goes; it fed only the message. That spec sentence alone measured about 190 characters at three verbs, so no verdict built on it fits; see Acceptance notes for what that leaves in `packages/spec`.
  - `validate-seed-state-machine.ts`: `atMostThree()` (new, module-private) bounds the known-state list.
  - `validate-field-consumers.ts`: the `sharedClause` expression names `sharedWith[0]` and counts the rest.
  - No helper changed shape (string in, string out); no truth table is involved.
- `.changeset/22161-lint-slice-10-one-line.md`: `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, naming every door that prints the new text (below). `Clause-②: no`, as line 2 says: every rule id these entries key already had an exported constant on the root barrel (`index.ts` is untouched), and slice 1's contract review (② of its record) reads `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entries as data in an existing export.
- **The declared rider went unused:** the `packages/cli` and `packages/metadata-protocol` tests that assert these ids' text pin fragments the new verdicts keep (`auth.credentialRef` and `every member who can read flows` for `flow-credential-literal`; the unchanged `inert` arm of `field-no-consumers`), and they ran green unedited (below).

The verdict forms, the longest of each arm the rule suites fired (the last line is `os validate` on the showcase app):

```text
connector input 'headers.Authorization' holds a credential-shaped literal, readable by every member who can read flows; drop it: the connector authenticates through `auth.credentialRef`
url query parameter 'api_key' holds a credential-shaped literal, readable by every member who can read flows; move it to a connector's `auth.credentialRef`
Agent "helper" (surface 'ask') references skill "metadata_authoring" (surface 'build'), so the runtime refuses the binding and chatting with this agent fails at request time
Tool family "crm_*" matches no tool this stack can resolve, so the subscription contributes zero tools at runtime
Tool "action_send_invoice" names action "send_invoice", which does not become an AI tool (it needs `ai.exposed` and a headless path), so the runtime drops the reference
Tool "knowledge_base" resolves to no stack, platform or materialised action tool, so the runtime drops it and the agent cannot call it. Did you mean "search_knowledge_base"?
Filter value "{DATEADD(day, -45)}" calls 'DATEADD', which neither the flow template dialect nor the filter placeholders define, so the evaluator raises a guard refusal and this node cannot run
`enable.apiMethods` advertises [create, update, delete], which `managedBy: 'better-auth'` affordances refuse (needs userActions create/edit/delete), so the registry strips them
Recipient `unit_and_subordinates` (a business unit AND every descendant unit) on an object that opted out of tenancy spans EVERY organization: a cross-org business-unit grant ADR-0105 D6 forbids
sets `allowRestore: false`, the retired default of a key removed in @objectstack/spec 17, which the parse strips in silence, so this line grants nothing
`mode: 'insert'` re-inserts every record on each replay boot (dev-server restart, package re-publish) with no existing-row check, so every restart duplicates its rows
seeds 'status=complete', which the 'proj' state machine does not declare (known states: active, cancelled, completed (and 2 more)), and seed writes skip that rule, so a typo lands silently
highlightFields points at "organization_id", an injected system column with no storage on this external object (ADR-0015), so every consumer renders it empty on every record
declared, but nothing in this stack displays or reads it (carrier-only: 4 site(s) name it without reading it; a consumer of the same name on "showcase_project_membership" (and 1 more) does not count)
```

## Shared prose: written once (the dispatch's route, measured)

| shared text | ids | where it is written once | held to its source by |
|---|---|---|---|
| who can read a flow's literal (`readable by every member who can read flows`) | `flow-credential-literal`, all three positions | `SERVED` in the rule file (verdict); the explanation's first paragraph (reasoning) | the rule's test, every position fired |

The dispatch expected shared paragraphs across ids, as slices 3 to 9 found. Measured: none of the 10 explanations shares a paragraph with another. The two AI rules judge different references (an agent's `skills`, a skill's `tools`) against different universes; the two seed rules answer different questions (replay idempotence, the state-machine exemption); `org-axis-cross-org-bu-grant`'s sibling `org-axis-permission-inheritance` is not converted (174 at its longest) and has no entry to share with. So the table holds the one in-file shared clause.

The explanation module imports nothing, so each fact it writes out is held to its source by the rule's own test: the credential positions and the three region kinds by firing each; the surface defaults, the `both` arm and the skipped unresolved skill by the existing cases; the three tool sources, the wildcard and the four headless paths by each one silencing the rule; the flow template functions to `FLOW_TEMPLATE_DATE_FUNCTIONS` and `FLOW_TEMPLATE_VALUE_FUNCTIONS`, and the placeholders by each one staying silent; the verb table to `MANAGED_WRITE_VERB_AFFORDANCE`, verb by verb through the rule; the business-unit recipients to the `ShareRecipientType` partition the suite pins, each fired; the retired keys and their residue value to the spec's capture; the declared-state union by each of its three sources silencing the rule; and the external-object provenance by the existing cases.

## Census (taken first, before any edit, at the base `23419bafb7`)

Method: slice 4 to 9's scratch preload (`NODE_OPTIONS=--import`, never committed), which patches `Array.prototype.push` to record every finding-shaped object (`rule` + `message`), deduped by (rule, message) per process, with the push site for the 11 ids and the other ids in their files. Lengths are `message` alone; the printed line adds `where` and `: `. Rows from `os lint`'s own printer (`commands/lint.ts:761`, which pushes `where: message`) are named as such. Positive control in every run: `field-no-consumers`, plus `sort-field-unknown` and `searchable-field-unknown` in the runtime-gate suite, recorded in every run.

- **`packages/lint` suite**, base 137 files / 6,416 tests, after the CLI, metadata-protocol and example closure build at the base: **all 10 ids fire**, every one over 200 at its longest; each longest equals PR #22799's list. `field-no-consumers`: 14 messages, longest 167.
- **`packages/cli` unit tier**, the whole project (281 files, 4,174 tests): fires none of the 10, before and after; `field-no-consumers` fires 7 messages, the longest 142 as `os lint`'s printer row, all on the unchanged `inert` arm.
- **Runtime publish gate:** the whole `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite (228 files, 225 run, 28,129 passed), which reads `@objectstack/lint` from its built `dist/`, before on the base-built dist and after on the rebuilt one: fires `flow-credential-literal` (3 messages, `runtime-authoring-gate.flow-credential-literal.test.ts`) and `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue` (2); none of the other 9.
- **Example apps:** `os validate` (the built CLI) on `app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-showcase` and `app-multi-package`, exit 0 each, before and after: **none of the 10 fire**; `field-no-consumers` fires on all four, and every app prints the same number of `rule:` lines before and after (9 / 7 / 70 / 3).
- **Extra, outside the dispatch's list:** the four `packages/cli` e2e files that name these ids (`flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts`, `rule-line-explain-pointer.e2e.test.ts`, `starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts`, `generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts`; in no per-PR vitest project, run here under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`) and the one integration file (`union-fold-command-parity.test.ts`).
- **After:** the lint `dist/` rebuilt from the slice at `dfec085942` (marker `holds a credential-shaped literal` 1 hit each in `dist/index.js`, `index.cjs`, `runtime.js`, `runtime.cjs`; the old `holds a literal value that reads as a credential` 0 in each; `why business-unit trees stay inside one organization` 1 in `dist/rule-explanations.js` and `.cjs`). Every after-run except the final lint suite read that dist; the commits after it add the changeset and the `origin/main` merge, which touches no `packages/lint` file.

| rule id | severity | lint suite: before (msgs · range) → after | runtime-gate suite | examples `os validate` | cli e2e (4 files) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flow-credential-literal` | warning | 10 · 282–390 → 10 · 144–185 | 3 · 294–390 → 3 · 148–181 | — | 3 · 294–390 → 3 · 148–181 (printer rows 346–430 → 188–233) |
| `ai-skill-surface-mismatch` | error | 6 · 259–281 → 6 · 151–173 | — | — | — |
| `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` | warning | 24 · 238–441 → 23 · 113–173 | — | — | — |
| `flow-filter-token-unknown` | error | 8 · 267–278 → 8 · 181–192 | — | — | — |
| `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` | error | 3 · 392–412 → 7 · 146–176 | — | — | — |
| `org-axis-cross-org-bu-grant` | error | 2 · 331–365 → 2 · 160–194 | — | — | — |
| `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue` | warning | 2 · 233–235 → 2 · 150–152 | 2 · 233–235 → 2 · 150–152 | — | — |

| `seed-value-outside-state-machine` | warning | 3 · 288–320 → 4 · 161–188 | — | — | — |

| `field-no-consumers` | warning | 14 · 64–167 → 19 · 64–178 | — | crm 4 · 202 → 4 · 184; todo 2 · 109 → 2 · 109; showcase 21 · 341 → 19 · 199; multi-package 1 · 64 → 1 · 64 | 4 · 64–108 → 4 · 64–108 |

The cli unit tier column is not drawn: it fires `field-no-consumers`' unchanged `inert` arm alone (7 · 64–142), before and after. The cli integration file fires `field-no-consumers` only (2 · 64–140, before and after). `org-axis-permission-inheritance` (not converted): lint suite 4 · 167–174 before and after. A message count that falls after (`ai-skill-tool-unresolved`, `semantic-role-field-unprovisioned`, showcase's `field-no-consumers`) is two findings whose old texts differed only in a name the verdict no longer repeats or a list it now cuts; a count that rises is a case this slice added. Every push site of the 11 ids fires before and after (one each, `semantic-role-field-unprovisioned`'s helper reached from its two roles).

## Doors that print the new text

Read from the registry (`authoring-rules.ts`): `lintFlowCredentialLiterals` and `validateFlowFilterTokens` are CLI and runtime on `['flow']`, `validateManagedApiMethods` on `['object']`, `validateRetiredPermissionResidue` on `['permission']`; `validateOrgAxisRedLines`, `validateFieldConsumers`, `validateSemanticRoles` and the two seed rules are CLI only; the two AI rules are members of the reference-integrity suite on its default `['flow']`. The CLI's callers: `commands/validate.ts`, `compile.ts` (`os build` is its alias), `lint.ts`, `verify.ts` through `judgeAuthorTimeRules` on the `validate` set, and `init.ts` through `validateScaffold` on the `build` set (one caller, `commands/init.ts:1314`; `commands/generate.ts` calls no authoring rule). Measured at the runtime door with `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on the rebuilt dist (scratch probe): a `flow` write answers `flow-filter-token-unknown` in `errors` and `flow-credential-literal` in `advisories`; an `object` write answers `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` in `errors`; a `permission` write answers `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue` in `advisories`; an `agent`, `skill` or `sharing_rule` write runs no rule.

| door | ids | what changes |
|---|---|---|
| `os validate`, `os build` (and `os compile`, which `os dev` runs at startup and, under `--verbose`, per watch recompile), `os lint` (`where: message`), the scaffold check `os init` runs | all 11 | the text-face verdict line; the `rule:` line gains the `os explain` pointer for the 10; `os validate --json` `errors` and `os build --json` author-time `issues` carry the new `message` |
| `os verify` | the four errors: `ai-skill-surface-mismatch`, `flow-filter-token-unknown`, `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable`, `org-axis-cross-org-bu-grant` | its refusal list; it counts advisories without printing them |
| runtime publish gate, `flow` write | `flow-filter-token-unknown` (error), `flow-credential-literal` (warning) | the 422 issue's `message` and the `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES` refusal log line; the 2xx `advisories` entry and the `[Protocol] authoring advisory` log line |
| runtime publish gate, `object` write | `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` (error) | the 422 issue's `message` and the refusal log line |
| runtime publish gate, `permission` write | `permission-retired-lifecycle-residue` (warning) | the 2xx `advisories` entry and the advisory log line |
| never at the runtime gate | `org-axis-cross-org-bu-grant`, both seed ids, `semantic-role-field-unprovisioned`, `field-no-consumers` (CLI-only rules); both AI ids (run there only for a `flow` write, whose snapshot carries no agents or skills) | |
| unchanged | every `hint`; every other rule id | |

Every row is named in the changeset.

## `field-no-consumers` across doors (the dispatch's item 6, measured on `examples/app-showcase`)

- `os validate`: 51 findings, each printed once (verdict, `fix:`, `rule:` with the pointer); the longest printed verdict line 391 → 253 characters.
- `os build`: 37 of them, each once, inside the 50-entry advisory cap (`… and 20 more author-time warning(s) not shown (50 of 70)`); longest printed verdict line 257 → 253.
- `os dev --compile --fresh`: the startup compile (`stdio: 'inherit'`) prints the same 37, once; a watch recompile prints its output only under `--verbose`, else only stderr on failure (`commands/dev.ts`, `startWatchRecompile`). Nothing is printed again at serve.
- **No second paragraph remains.** `Give … a consumer` and `Roots scanned` appear 0 times in the `os validate`, `os build` and `os dev` output, before and after: stage 1 moved that text into the explanation. No `packages/cli` printer was edited.

## Tests

The rule suites import the rule source; the CLI, runtime-gate, example and e2e runs read the rebuilt `@objectstack/lint` dist. Every heavy run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; its VERDICT lines are quoted.

- **Each rule's own suite pins the new shape**, as in slices 2 to 9. The eleven touched suites wrap their rule import and record every finding their direct calls fire; the LAST case in each file holds every recorded verdict of its id to one line of at most 200 characters, behind a coverage control (each arm: all three credential positions; both surface directions; all three tool arms; one and several refused verbs; both business-unit recipients; both retired keys; a cut and an uncut state list; both semantic roles; and `field-no-consumers`' `inert`, `carrier-only`, one-name and counted arms). Exact pins hold one verdict per arm; explanation pins hold, per id, that `explainRule(id)` exists and names what the verdict stopped saying, and the source-held facts above. Every refusal assertion, rule id, severity, `path`, `where` and hint pin is unchanged. The pins that read the old text moved to the new verdict: the credential route fragments to `move it to a connector's auth.credentialRef` (and the hint's `type: 'bearer', credentialRef`, newly pinned beside the existing `headerName` one); the AI tool suite's `/references tool "…"/` matcher to `/^Tool "…"/` and `tool family` to `Tool family`.
- **Lint suite** at the final head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 137 passed (137), Tests 6,455 passed (6,455); VERDICT command-exit 0 (base 137 / 6,416; no new file, 39 new cases).
- **Lint build + typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build` (VERDICT command-exit 0, `check-dts-emitted` 6/6), and after the merge `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/lint` (4 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck` at the final head: VERDICT command-exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` OK, 2 files / 6 errors / 2 pinned signatures held. `tsc -p packages/lint/tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all eleven touched test files.
- **CLI unit tier**, against the rebuilt lint dist: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 281 passed (281), Tests 4,174 passed (4,174), before and after; VERDICT command-exit 0 both. It includes `test/explain-rule-id.test.ts`. The integration tier is declared to CI (no file in it asserts these ids' text, and the diff touches no spawn entry); its one file naming these ids ran as the census extra: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 9 passed (9), before and after.
- **CLI e2e files naming these ids** (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`): Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 56 passed (56), before and after; VERDICT command-exit 0 both. `flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts` asserts the message carries `auth.credentialRef` at every door; it does.
- **Runtime gate:** the whole `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite, before and after: Test Files 225 passed | 3 skipped (228), Tests 28,129 passed | 19 skipped (28,148), both runs; VERDICT command-exit 0. `runtime-authoring-gate.flow-credential-literal.test.ts` asserts `every member who can read flows` and `auth.credentialRef`; both are kept.
- **Corpus pins over `packages/lint/src`:** `git grep lint/src -- packages/spec/src` names two that walk it, `src/shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` (judges every `os migrate meta --from N` sentence) and `src/identity/position-delegatable-enforcer.pin.test.ts` (reads `security-*` rule-id lines); the other hits name single files outside this slice or are comments. No new text carries the migrate marker (the residue explanation names `os migrate meta` without `--from`), and no rule-id line moved. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` at the final head: Test Files 55 passed (55), Tests 971 passed (971); VERDICT command-exit 0. Both pins are in its `vitest.repo-tests.json` list.
- **Tracker ids:** no `#` plus digits in any printed message or explanation (`rule-explanations.test.ts` refuses one in every paragraph); the citations stay in `//` comments and test names.
- **Ablation** (one-shot, from the committed state `92a7bebbb4`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode under the verify lock, plus a shell `trap` restoring `HEAD` by absolute path). The rule suites import the rule source, so there is no dist leg. `seed-insert-mode-duplicates-on-replay`'s pre-slice message tail was restored verbatim through the anchor of its new tail: anchor x1 → x0, blob `2e2c47f4e718` → `9acef22a58d3`. Predicted before the run: exactly two cases red, the id's exact-text pin and the 200-character bound pin; the suite's other assertion on the message (`toContain('replay')`) holds on the old text too. Observed: `src/validate-seed-replay-safety.test.ts` Test Files 1 failed (1), Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9); the two red cases are exactly those two (the bound pin read 222 characters). Restored: blob `2e2c47f4e718` == blob at HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **ESLint, narrowed:** `npx eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 23 changed `.ts` files gave 23 files in the report, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is `eslint.config.mjs`'s `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']` block plus the `packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}` blocks, which all 23 are in (the changeset is not a linted kind). `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules; the config's own note says so), so no untouched file's verdict can move. A control-character scan of every changed file found no match.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths, at the final head `82555d5ca8` (merge base `b7cd1af9df`, after one merge of `origin/main` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`; the merge touched no `packages/lint` file, and its step 2 took `origin/main`'s side of the generated artifacts main moved, none of which this branch edits), derived 62 commands. I ran 60 of them sequentially at that head, each with its own log and its exit code captured before any pipe: all 60 exited 0. Two are NOT MEASURED, as the dispatch directs: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (it needs every package's `dist/`, and the dispatch excludes a whole-workspace build) and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` (`--re-measure`, which builds every package); the non-re-measuring half, `check:type-check-coverage`, ran and exited 0. `--ran` over the exit-coded record: `Run reconciliation — 62 derived, 60 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.` The artifact-roster block the no-path run prints (51 families) ran too: the 48 that need no pull request all exited 0, `check:published-readme-exports` only after one `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3: `client-react`, `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-ragflow` and `organizations` had no `dist/`; I built exactly those four with their closure under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, and it then exited 0). The four rostered under a directory this diff touches (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) are among the 48. The three PR-context guards (`check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check-single-claim-paths`) run against this PR once it exists, and their verdicts go to the card report (this body is written once). The long ones on the shared box: `check:query-options-erasure` 249s, `check:slot-lookup` 135s, `check-comment-mask-corpus` 112s.

## Remaining for this card

- **`packages/lint`:** no author-time id outside the fenced files fires over 200 characters in the lint suite after this slice. Measured over the final census: 28 ids still exceed 200; 26 are PR #22448's fenced ids, and 2 are `lint-startup-registry-verdict.ts`'s (`startup-open-vocabulary-verdict` 779, `startup-verdict-assertive-wording` 731), which PR #22448 records as the repo gate `check:startup-registry-verdict`'s, not an author's. `react-prop-deprecated` fires in no suite, as PR #22700 notes.
- **The fenced ids, as PR #22448 lists them (26):** `lint-flow-patterns.ts` (15), `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` (3), `validate-component-props.ts` (2), `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (2), `validate-expressions.ts` (1, `expression-invalid`), `validate-filter-tokens.ts` (1, `filter-token-unknown`), `validate-form-layout.ts` (1), `validate-print-page-blocks.ts` (1).
- **The 9 ids owned by `packages/cli`,** as PR #22448 lists them: `hook-body/not-lowerable`, `hook-body/unparseable`, `hook-body/bundled-fallback`, `hook-body/extraction-failed` (`packages/cli/src/lint/hook-body-lowering.ts`); `docs/uncollected-directory`, `docs/duplicate-name`, `docs/nav-target`, `docs/frontmatter-tags` (`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`); `picklist-reference-unverified` (`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts`).
